meta_description:
7,969 likes, 538 comments - shivesh17 on October 8, 2026: "Disney magic, but at sea! 🚢✨🏰

The Disney Adventure from Singapore has 7 immersive areas to explore, each with its own little world, from Disney Imagination Garden and San Fransokyo Street to Marvel Landing and Wayfinder Bay! 🥹✨

A few things to know before you go:
🎢 Don’t miss the longest roller coaster at sea
🎆 Stay back for the fireworks & nighttime shows
🍦 Yes, the unlimited soft serve is FREE
🍽️ There are plenty of dining options + 24/7 room service
📍 Give yourself enough time to explore all 7 areas because there’s SO much to do!

Basically, come hungry, keep your camera ready and prepare to feel like a kid again! 🥹❤️

And if you’re planning your own Disney Adventure, book by 20 Dec 2026 and enjoy 50% off voyage fares for the 3rd and 4th Guests sharing a stateroom with 2 full-fare Guests, on select sailings from 4 Jan–16 Dec 2027. 

Comment DISNEY to get the link to book this experience 🤍

@disneycruiselinesg
#disneycruiseadventure
#TravelwithShivesh".
